# Procurement

## Thresholds

Purchases above 40000 dollars require three competing vendor bids and sign-off from the chief financial officer. Purchases below that amount need one quote and approval from the budget owner.

## Vendor onboarding

New vendors are onboarded through the Quartz procurement system. Onboarding takes about eight working days and includes a sanctions screening.

## Confidential supplier rates

The negotiated day rate with our main logistics supplier is 1375 dollars. This figure is restricted to the finance team.
